event: Daily Intelligence Briefing
title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Defensive rotation, semis cracked.
Sept CPI (Oct 14, fc 3.6% y/y) still ahead; today's tape read the Oct 7 NY Fed 1-yr inflation print at 3.9% vs 3.64% fc, and the response was staples over chips. Money left XLK for XLP, SPY's 0.9x volume says this was positioning, not broad liquidation.

INDICES — VIX 15.4, below its 20-day 15.7; VIXY +1.91%.
DIA +0.12%, SPY -0.42%, IWM -0.05%, QQQ -1.34%, SOXX -3.35%. Small > large by 0.59pp. TLT +0.94% and USO +2.55% were the cross-asset tells — bonds and crude bid while semis sold.

VOLUME & BREADTH — SPY 0.9x (ignored), QQQ 1.5x (heavy), SOXX 1.6x into a -3.35% drop = distribution. RSP 1.7x gaining with RSP +0.60% = accumulation in equal-weight. Breadth: 337/162 adv/dec, up/down vol 1.51, 12 new highs vs 14 new lows, but only 32% above the 50-DMA and 46% above the 200-DMA — participation is narrow despite the green advance line.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLP Staples +2.11%, XLC Comms +0.73%, XLRE Real Estate +0.69%, XLB Materials +0.59%, XLY Discretionary +0.31%, XLI Industrials +0.00%, XLF Financials +0.00%, XLE Energy +0.00%, XLU Utilities -0.19%, XLV Healthcare -0.39%, XLK Technology -1.79%.
Top industries XOP +2.79% and USO +2.55%; bottom DRAM -5.13% and WGMI -6.40%.
Flows: XLU +$2,313mm (100p) and XLK +$1,771mm (100p) led 5-day inflows; XLB -$201mm (10p) and XLP -$104mm (44p) saw outflows — flows contradict today's staples bid, marking it short-covering, not conviction. Weakest: memory/DRAM and crypto-miners. Rotation-state: 'AI hardware fading / high-to-low rotation'.

POSITIONING — SPY PCR 0.96, QQQ 1.05 = mild protection demand, not panic. Skew positive (SPY +4.0%, QQQ +5.9%) = puts bid. VIXEQ 39.8 vs VIX 15.4 — the widest gap in the block = high single-stock dispersion, a stock-picker's tape, not macro-correlated.

CROSS-ASSET — Crude +2.55% came with EIA inventories -318.6 vs +172.2 fc (Oct 7) — a large draw lifting XOP and FCG while DRAM and WGMI broke. TLT +0.94% against UUP -0.21% is the classic softer-dollar, duration-bid pairing. Next FOMC Oct 28: Polymarket prices 84% no change / 16% hike.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 57.2 (Neutral). Movers: VST -6.35%, ORCL -5.48%, INTC -5.34%, MDT +2.62%. Vol spikes: PEP 2.5x at +3.73%, UTES 3.7x at -1.83% (distribution).
Watch: MDT on 5.2x volume and +2.62% (accumulation); SOXX 1.6x with SOXX -3.35% and -$2,328mm 5-day outflow (0p); UTES 3.7x at -1.83% for gamma/vol stress.

Word count: ~430.
